subject: LumenHealth workspace & API access — kickoff and keying cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenHealth workspace & API access — kickoff and keying cadence

Hi all,

Quick kickoff note to align on the initial tenant provisioning and API key seeding plan for Lumen Health (DEAL-8471). Attached is a lightweight tenant-provisioning-template.csv and a draft SOW for the onboarding scope.

High-level goals for this first week:
- Provision a single org namespace (lumen-prod) and two projects (svc-inference, svc-analytics).
- Seed two admin API keys for Lumen (one primary, one emergency) and create a service account for background jobs.
- Configure roles: Owner (Lumen admin), Integration (service account), ReadOnly (audit group).
- Confirm KMS preferences and whether Lumen will provide a customer-managed key (CMK).
- Invite initial users (3 admins + 2 devs) and confirm invite cadence (link expiry, MFA requirement).

Karthik — can you propose a minimal timeline and owners for each bullet? Jonas — I want you to own the invite cadence and session with their SRE to walk through service-account policy.

Sara — can you share the procurement contact we should loop in and confirm whether Lumen requires a SOC2 evidence set before we seed keys? If you prefer, we can delay seeding until procurement signs the SOW, but that typically pushes the invite window out 2–3 business days.

Attachments: tenant-provisioning-template.csv, sow-draft.pdf

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Jun 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth workspace & API access — kickoff and keying cadence

Thanks Monica — good starter list. Proposed minimal timeline below (can tighten if procurement allows key seeding prior to signature):

Day 0 (today) — kickoff and stakeholder list confirmed.
Day 1 — org and project creation + KMS question resolved. Deliverable: tenant stub and role matrix. (Owner: Karthik)
Day 2 — seed admin API keys into secure vault; create service account and map roles. Deliverable: API key fingerprints + service-account principal. (Owner: Karthik)
Day 3 — invite admin users and run invite acceptance test; run a short smoke test against svc-inference. (Owner: Jonas)
Day 4 — handoff to Lumen SRE for baseline traffic test / latency check. (Owners: Jonas + Lumen SRE)

Notes / open items:
- KMS: if Lumen will provide a CMK, we need the key ARN and allowed principals by EOD tomorrow. If not, we will use Redwood-managed encryption but log the decision.
- Temporary access: we suggest expiring initial invite links after 72 hours and issuing ephemeral API keys for the service account with a 30-day rotation policy.
- Audit trail: we'll attach tenant creation events to ONB-5621 (JIRA) and share a link to the mutual-action-plan doc.

Sara — can you confirm a primary technical contact and whether procurement wants us to upload SOC2 evidence here or via the procurement portal?

Karthik
Sr. Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

> > Quick kickoff note to align on the initial tenant provisioning and API key seeding plan for Lumen Health (DEAL-8471). Attached is a lightweight tenant-provisioning-template.csv and a draft SOW for the onboarding scope.

From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumen Health Purchasing <purchasing@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Jun 2029 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth workspace & API access — kickoff and keying cadence

Thanks Monica and Karthik — appreciate the clear plan. A few items from our side:

- Primary tech contact: me (Sara Connors), with SRE lead Samir Patel (samir.patel@lumenhealth.com) joining the invite/test.
- Procurement: enumarate (sic) purchasing@lumenhealth.com on SOW for signature. They prefer DocuSign and want a copy of the SOC2 link — I can provide a read-only link to our portal but would rather Redwood upload the evidence to our procurement portal once access is established.
- KMS: Lumen will supply a customer-managed KMS key. I will share the ARN and the principal list by EOD tomorrow.
- Timeline: procurement will likely sign within 48 hours of receiving the finalized SOW. If possible, please prepare for key seeding pre-signature but gate distribution of the primary admin key until we confirm signature. Emergency key can be seeded to a locked vault with access controlled by buying team.

Attachments referenced: none.

Sara
Director, Platform Integrations
Lumen Health
sara.connors@lumenhealth.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Connors <sara.connors@lumenhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Jun 2029 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth workspace & API access — kickoff and keying cadence

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Sara. Summary of next steps and owners: 

1) Karthik — create tenant (lumen-prod) + projects and draft the role mapping doc by EOD tomorrow. Attach tenant-provisioning-template.csv updates to ONB-5621.
2) Karthik — prepare key-seeding playbook so we can seed emergency key into reserved vault pre-signature; hold primary admin key distribution until DocuSign completes.
3) Jonas — invite flow and acceptance test planned for Day 3; coordinate a 30-min smoke window with Samir for Day 3 afternoon.
4) Sara — send KMS ARN and procurement DocuSign routing; add Samir to the thread.
5) Monica — I will create the mutual action plan link and add it to the HubSpot deal record (DEAL-8471).

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LmAq-example-MAP (mutual action plan)
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-8471
JIRA: ONB-5621

I'll follow up with calendar invites and a short checklist that Jonas can use for the invite acceptance test. If anyone needs to change owners, call it out here.

Best,

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-link.txt (link to MAP)
